notes: Matches come from RSSSF's list (updated to 2026), with the 1 played since from Spanish Wikipedia; knockout ties and totals from Wikipedia.
Matches decided on penalties count as draws; the shoot-out decides only who went through.
The source's own totals table counts 246 official matches (114–61–71); the match list adds up to 245 (114–63–68).
The top scorers are counted from the scorers listed for each match (222 of the 225 matches with goals have them), so they may differ slightly from other sources.
